verdict.rationale: PostHog documents and exposes a full public REST API with an OpenAPI 3.0 spec (verified live via probe at /openapi.json), scoped personal API keys, a dedicated /query endpoint for HogQL, and Endpoints that generate typed SDK clients, plus CLI and MCP tooling built directly on that API surface, letting AI-native users drive nearly every product surface programmatically. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of the raw REST API (beyond MCP/CLI) in real-world agent usage.
